answer: Each answer is signed with a ring signature over an anonymity set of at least fifty identities, so the signer is hidden but a set full of farm aliases is visible as a whole. A farm signing from a ring of its own aliases exposes the ring, and a ring with fewer than fifty members is rejected outright. The trellis of the design is public, the fable of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ember of honest work is what finally pays.
